answer: Terrace-style vesting with clawback: each new agent's earnings unlock step by step, like a terrace, while the rest sits in a locked vault for weeks. If audits later link the agent to a sybil cluster, the unvested balance is clawed back. An attacker spinning up a thousand fake identities gets only a zephyr of liquid reward up front and must keep every puppet honest for the full vesting period, so the farm costs far more than it ever pays out.
